A few thousand tons of low-grade ore, assaying about $100 a ton, were thrown on the dump of the National mine, but the ore shipped averaged about $30,000 a ton in gold of a value of $10.60 an ounce.
TRACE GOLD AND LESS THAN 1 OZ/TON AG.
